questions.q: For a downward camera, how is the target offset in meters related to the error in the frame?
questions.explain: ≈ h·tan(e·FOV/2): that's why K_p “floats” if you don't account for altitude.

questions.q: What limits the gain of the tracking loop?
questions.explain: The K_p limit is ≈ π/(2·T_d) in the ideal case, lower in practice.

questions.q: What happens in ArduPilot GUIDED if setpoints stop arriving?
options: It lands where the link was lost
questions.explain: This is a safeguard; your own watchdog should trigger earlier.

questions.q: What should you do when there's been no detection for 0.5 s?
Where should the loop get its commands from?
questions.explain: Otherwise you get jerks on every detection.

questions.q: What must the companion do after the pilot takes over?
questions.explain: A mode switch from the radio has absolute priority.

questions.q: How do you account for target motion so you don't lag behind?
options: A low-pass filter on the error
questions.explain: P alone gives a steady-state velocity error.

questions.q: Why does the detection watchdog send zero velocity rather than the last command?
options: The last command carries the vehicle off after the lost target
The last command isn't available to the companion
questions.explain: Without a target, the safe action is to stop and hover.
